prompt: How many active players have won one or more ATP Finals singles titles? Please note that Andy Murray is no longer active.
answer:
**Five active players** have won at least one ATP Finals singles title:

- Novak Djokovic — 7
- Alexander Zverev — 2
- Grigor Dimitrov — 1
- Stefanos Tsitsipas — 1
- Daniil Medvedev — 1

Andy Murray also won the title once, but he is retired and therefore excluded.
